columns.name: project_id
columns.description: [CUSTERED] Name of the project from which the query was made

columns.name: user_or_project
columns.description: [CUSTERED] Name of the user or project responsible for the query

columns.name: user_email
columns.description: Email of the user that executed the job

columns.name: job_id
columns.description: Job ID assigned when query is executed

columns.name: job_type
columns.description: The type of the job. Can be query, load, extract, copy or unknown

columns.name: cache_hit
columns.description: Whether the query results of this job were from a cache

columns.name: creation_date
columns.description: [PARTITIONED] Date in which the job was created

columns.name: statement_type
columns.description: The type of query statement. For example, DELETE, INSERT, SELECT or UPDATE

columns.name: state
columns.description: Running state of the job. Valid states include PENDING, RUNNING, and DONE

columns.name: total_mb_billed
columns.description: Number of Mb billed by of the job execution

columns.name: total_mb_processed
columns.description: Number of Mb processed by the job execution

columns.name: total_s_slot_usage
columns.description: Slot seconds for the job over its entire duration in the RUNNING state, including retries
